title: SuperDash 1.7.1 — Plan Mobile UI Redesign & Cloudflare Edge
summary: Major mobile UI redesign for the Plan app featuring Microsoft To-Do scale, Claude/Anthropic typography, compact side navigation, and integrated vector glyphs.
highlights: Plan App mobile redesign: Microsoft To-Do scale, comfortable 48-56px touch targets
Claude / Anthropic style calm, legible sans-serif typography across Plan & Tasks
Compact side navigation drawer with dark blurred backdrop overlay
Integrated single-glyph Add Task / Add Note vector action icons
Deployed to Cloudflare Pages high-speed edge CDN

changes.description: Marketing and client-retention app: Today action dashboard, lightweight leads pipeline, client relationship timeline, and 10 practical playbooks.
Resolved Android download issues with native DownloadManager integration, direct APK fallback, and live remote manifest queries.
Simplified Home composition: compact header, universal search, clean 4-column grid with Growth icon.
Header sliders button opens a native Liquid Glass Bottom Sheet without shifting or expanding the header.
